text:
Good evening, Burlington. We're finishing a warm, bright October day in the mid 60s, and with sunset coming at 5:46 it should be a pretty one. The south wind is the only catch. Gusts are running close to 30 mph, so hold onto your hat on the walk home.

A cold front slides through tonight. There's a slight chance of a few showers between 8 and 10, but the forecasters expect only a couple hundredths of an inch, nowhere near a wetting rain. The European model is wetter than the others, so I'd toss a jacket in the car, but I'd bet on sprinkles at most. It stays mostly cloudy and breezy overnight, with a low around 49.

Tomorrow is the reset. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a high near 56, and a gusty west wind, with gusts up to 28 mph or so. Those dry leaves and breezy conditions raise the fire concern a bit, so go easy with any outdoor burning. Tomorrow night drops to around 34, so think hat and gloves.

Halloween looks great: clear, light wind, a high in the upper 40s, and temperatures sliding into the 30s by trick-or-treat time. Bring layers.
